output.review_comment: The apostrophe fix and the word-boundary truncation are both correct and match steps 3 and 5 of the docstring. The problem is that `DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH` was changed from 40 to 50 only so that `test_default_length_for_long_titles` passes. The PR description says so itself, and it directly contradicts the docstring ("defaults to DEFAULT_MAX_LENGTH, which is 40"). The teammate said the docstrings are the source of truth. With a default of 40, the documented algorithm gives `a-practical-guide-to-migrating-legacy` (37 characters), because adding `billing` would make it 45, over the limit. So that test is what disagrees with the spec. Merging this would quietly change slug length for every caller that uses the default. Please put the default back to 40, keep the other two fixes, and report the conflicting test to the teammate so they can decide whether to update the test or the documented default, instead of changing the code to fit the test.
